title.en: DeepSeek Harness is now a supported download

description.en: DeepSeek's open-source agent harness (dsh) moves from "coming soon" to installable on the Install page. It runs in headless mode — one run per message — with your API key kept out of the command line and a private per-agent home so your own ~/.dsh setup is never touched. Heads up: the runtime is a large install (about 360 MB) and needs a DEEPSEEK_API_KEY before it will answer.
